sources.title: Kate Crawford
sources.quote_checked: AI is the extractive industry of the 21st century. | It's much more diverse than the internet would have you believe.

sources.title: Excavating the Politics of AI: An Interview with Kate Crawford
sources.quote_checked: After all, AI is politics all the way down. | AI is becoming an extractive industry of the 21st century. | the hidden forms of labour extracted all along the supply chain | the data extracted from all of us as data subjects | dual operation of abstraction and extraction | distances it from the energy, labour and capital needed to produce it | Supply chains for information capitalism are extremely hard to research. | AI invariably amplifies and reproduces the forms of power it has been deployed to optimize. | the tendency for humans to accept decisions from automated systems more readily than other humans

sources.title: Kate Crawford (personal site, bio)
sources.quote_checked: Kate Crawford is a leading scholar of artificial intelligence. | She is a Professor at the University of Southern California | and the inaugural visiting chair of AI and Justice at the École Normale Supérieure in Paris. | In 2026, she is also a Weizenbaum Distinguished Fellow and Amherst College Presidential Scholar.
